original_hook: 📰 Cointelegraph reports $449M in Bitcoin ETF outflows over three days, led by $164M in a single day from ARK 21Shares. Source: Stablecoin wallets challenge traditional bank accounts as main consumer money hub Yet spot $BTC remains tightly compressed near $77,300 within a 3.88% range. Hotter U.S. Core CPI (0.3%) pushed bond yields higher, driving institutional desks to rebalance risk into yield. These ETF redemptions force arbitrage desks to sell spot BTC, but organic orderbook bids around $77,000 are quietly absorbing the selling without triggering retail capitulation. If redemptions continue for a fourth day and force price below $77,000 on volume, macro pressure wins out. But if this floor holds through the outflows, redemption supply risk exhausts into a squeeze. Bullish, bearish, or wait?
